author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you want to experience the China you see in our videos, come travel with us:
https://littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

This video is the start of a new road trip through one of China’s most stunning regions. Here’s a little hint: it’s very Tibetan there.
Before we set off, we were happy to spend a couple of days accompanying our tour group in northern Yunnan and to give you a short glimpse of what our tours are like.
